agendaDesktop.step4Title: From the panel to the calendar
agendaDesktop.step1Desc: See everything. Drag your unscheduled tasks into the calendar in one move.
agendaDesktop.step2Desc: Hour-by-hour detail (Day), the big picture (Week), or wider context (Month).
agendaDesktop.step3Desc: Open the list of tasks to schedule. Drag one onto a slot to add it to your calendar.
agendaDesktop.step4Desc: Grab a task, drag it onto a slot. It lands in your calendar in one gesture.
agendaDesktop.step5Desc: Grab the bottom of the event and drag down to make it longer.
agendaDesktop.step6Desc: Select a time slot to create an event there.

agendaMobile.step1Desc: A vertical day view, built for thumb scrolling. Tap the highlighted areas to discover the essentials.
agendaMobile.step2Desc: Swipe horizontally to browse your upcoming days. Tap a date to center it in the grid below.
agendaMobile.step3Desc: Day for hour-by-hour detail, 2D to compare two days, Month for wider context. One tap to switch.
agendaMobile.step4Desc: This button opens your unscheduled tasks. Tap one to pick a slot for it.
agendaMobile.step5Desc: The “+” button at the bottom of the screen opens the form in a bottom sheet, pre-filled with the current time on the selected day.
agendaMobile.step6Desc: Press and hold an empty time range in the grid to create an event right at that hour.

habitsDesktop.step2Title: Three ways to see your habits
habitsDesktop.step3Title: Create one in a few clicks
habitsDesktop.step1Desc: Set up things to repeat every day. Cosmo helps you keep your streak going.
habitsDesktop.step2Desc: List: weekly tracking. Board: a grid of the last 30 days. Overall tracking: statistics across all your habits.
habitsDesktop.step3Desc: Give it a name and pick a color.
habitsDesktop.step4Desc: The button ticks off today's habit and extends your streak. A missed day resets it to zero.

habitsMobile.step4Title: Tick it off with one tap
habitsMobile.step1Desc: A habit is a behavior you repeat every day, or several times a week. One tap is enough to tick off the day.
habitsMobile.step3Desc: The floating button at the bottom right opens the form. Name, color, cadence: 30 seconds to set up.
habitsMobile.step4Desc: Tap the ✓ button on a habit to mark today as done. The card changes color. Tap again to undo a mistaken tap.
habitsMobile.step5Desc: Under each habit, a strip shows your last 30 days: the fuller it is, the more consistent you've been. A quick read on your regularity.

okrDesktop.step1Desc: OKR = Objective (your goal) + Key Results (the metric). Clarity and alignment, guaranteed.
okrDesktop.step2Desc: Split your OKRs across Work, Personal, Health... Filter by area. The “+” creates a category.
okrDesktop.step3Desc: Set an objective and break it down into metrics (KRs).
okrDesktop.step4Desc: Add your metrics to your to-do list or to your calendar.

okrMobile.step1Desc: OKR = Objective (an ambitious direction) + Key Results (3-5 numeric indicators). The method startups use to move in the right direction.
okrMobile.step2Desc: Swipe the chips sideways to filter your objectives (Work, Personal, Health…). Tap “All” to reset.
okrMobile.step3Desc: The floating button at the bottom right opens the form. Set 3 to 5 measurable KRs, no more, or you spread yourself thin.
okrMobile.step4Desc: Tap the card to open the details. The gauge on the right shows overall health. Each KR has its own progress bar, adjustable with a tap.
okrMobile.step5Desc: Tip: create your OKRs first. Then create tasks that move a KR forward. Your dashboard will reflect real progress.

tasksDesktop.step1Title: All your tasks in one place
tasksDesktop.step1Desc: Title, priority, category, due date, duration. Everything you need to run your tasks.
tasksDesktop.step2Desc: Group your tasks into lists (Work, Home, Projects...). Click a list to see it on its own.
tasksDesktop.step3Desc: Keyword search, category filter, priority slider. In an instant.
tasksDesktop.step4Desc: A mini calendar of your due dates. Spot overloaded weeks at a glance.
tasksDesktop.step5Desc: Organize your work into tasks to get more done.
tasksDesktop.step6Desc: See all your tasks at a glance.

tasksMobile.step1Desc: This is where you run all your tasks. Swipe a row right to complete it, left for options.
tasksMobile.step2Desc: Your lists (Work, Shopping, Travel…) live here. Tap a list to filter. Swipe the carousel to see them all.
tasksMobile.step3Desc: Search lives at the bottom of the screen, under your thumb. Leave it empty and it offers its filters: Starred, Done, Overdue, Shared, Select.
tasksMobile.step4Desc: This button sets how the list shows up: list or board view, a mini calendar of your due dates, category colors.
tasksMobile.step5Desc: The + at the bottom right creates a task. A name is enough, everything else is optional.
tasksMobile.step6Desc: On a task, swipe your finger to the right. A green “Complete” area appears. Let go: the task is ticked (with a light vibration).
